Earlier scenes:

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines two time expressions; use the shorter time expression here. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到很多人正在吃一些植物，use 看到 when the meaning is “see”; 看 means “look at.” [vocab list]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 帮别人：帮助他们，别人 distinguishes other people from a stated speaker or person, while 他们 clearly refers to the people who are becoming ill. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一天，神农正在路上走：一天，他正在路上走，because the name appeared in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing character has appeared, use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: none]

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a time period with 的时候, and “在古代” is correct.
The original wrongly uses 看 in this structure; “看到很多人正在吃一些植物” is a grammatical alternative phrasing.
别人 does not refer back to the specific people already mentioned, whereas 他们 does.
神农 was just introduced and there is no competing referent, so the close re-reference should use 他.
